sentences: A maximal matching cannot be enlarged by adding one more edge, even though it need not have maximum size.
The saved question concerns maintaining such a matching as graph edges change.
After deletion of a matched edge, newly unmatched vertices may require fast repair using their remaining neighbors.
Sharper dynamic guarantees would improve a basic local allocation primitive used in many graph algorithms.
The source label does not fix deterministic versus randomized computation, worst-case versus amortized time, or the target update bound, so those distinct frontiers remain unmerged.
